papers.title: A Theory of Usable Information Under Computational Constraints
papers.findings: Predictive-family-relative optimum log risk; optional ignorance and nested-family monotonicity. Theorem1 is an absolute-deviation bound under uniformly bounded log density and controlled function-family complexity, not a guarantee for one trained model. Appendix proof uses uniform deviations and union bound.
papers.limits: Definitions/main guarantees and A.2/A.3 proof scope read. p6 structure-learning opening, p18 corollary opening and p24 limitations only; not complete corollary/experiments/code/whole-paper review or independent theorem certification. Acquired exact arxiv preprint, not publisher-final certification.
